title: Interrupted solution copies are permanently skipped on retry
reasoning: copytree creates the final destination before copying all files. An interruption or copy error can leave an incomplete directory. A subsequent invocation treats its existence as sufficient to skip migration, leaving the destination incomplete while the retry can finish successfully. Originals remain intact, but the migrated solution is not reliable.
reproduction: Interrupt copying after the destination directory and one file have been created, then rerun migration. The incomplete destination is reported as already existing and missing files are never copied.
recommendation: Copy into a temporary sibling directory and publish the destination only after successful completion. Validate existing destinations or report an explicit conflict rather than assuming existence means completion.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No migration tests were included, particularly failure-and-retry coverage.
suggestedRegressionTest: Inject copy failures at multiple stages, retry, and verify that no incomplete final destination is accepted and all source files remain unchanged.
minimumFixScope: Solution-copy publication and existing-destination validation in migrate_problem.
